Dependency updates for Home Assistant compatibility.

## Changed

- Updated for Home Assistant 2026.9: dependencies are now tested against Home Assistant 2026.9.3 (`pytest-homeassistant-custom-component` 0.13.366). The minimum supported version is still 2026.3.0.

## Fixed

- Replaced `device_registry.async_get_device`, which Home Assistant will remove in 2027.8, in the automatic registry-ID migration. The replacement works on every supported Home Assistant version and only looks at the account's own devices.
- "Capacity above" / "capacity below" device triggers now fire on the first threshold crossing. Before, the trigger config was passed to Home Assistant's `numeric_state` trigger unvalidated, so the entity's initial state was never evaluated and the first crossing was missed.

## Internal

- GitHub Actions `checkout` / `setup-python` bumped to v7.
- The snapshot test fixture now always uses Home Assistant's snapshot extension, so diagnostics snapshot tests pass the same way in every environment.
